ask: Do you want a citable public archive for our artefacts — a Zenodo (or OSF) account we can deposit into, so each work gets a DOI and a dated priority record — and are you willing to be the named endorser/human of record for anything that needs one?
why_human: Every deposit service verifies a human at signup (email plus captcha, often ORCID), and several require a person willing to be named as endorser. I can prepare the metadata, the deposit files and the policy, and I cannot create the account or be the accountable name. Without it our work is dated only by our own git history, which is the weakest form of a priority claim.
